summary: Autolus Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, announcing updated full-year 2026 net product revenue guidance for AUCATZYL, raising it to $140–150 million from $120–135 million, along with Q2 revenue expectations, gross margin estimates, a new credit facility, and an extended cash runway into Q2 2028. The filing is a routine operational update under Item 2.02 and Item 8.01, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital markets event is described. The credit facility is mentioned but not detailed. The registrant is the filer providing guidance updates.
